body:
# This plugin will not recieve anymore updates for a longwhile. Due to me being very busy in real life and having a job.
Admin-Abuse is a lightweight Paper/Spigot broadcast plugin focused on flashy “admin abuse” style announcements with full color support.​

Features
Simple commands for global announcements, including a dedicated “Admin Abuse” countdown that hypes up events before they start.​

Supports legacy color codes (&a, &b, &l, etc.) and modern hex colors (like #ff00ff) in both chat and titles for highly customized messages.​​
-# it should also support minimessage format (i think)

Sends synchronized chat broadcasts and on-screen titles to all online players, making sure no one misses important messages.​

Commands

`/broadcast <message>` – Sends a formatted global announcement with full color support.​

`/adminabuse <message>` – Instantly blasts an “ADMIN ABUSE” style alert to everyone.​

`/adminabusestart <message>` – Starts a short countdown (3…2…1…) and then triggers an “ADMIN ABUSE” broadcast.

`/chunkban <player>` Bans someone from the chunk.

`/chunkunban <player>` Unbans someone from the chunk.​​

Permissions
`eee.broadcast` – Allows use of `/broadcast`.​

`eee.adminabuse` – Allows use of `/adminabuse` and `/adminabusestart`.

`eee.chunkban` - Alows use of `/chunkban`.

`eee.chunkunban` - Alows use of `/chunkun~~~~ban`.​

Compatibility
Server: Spigot / Paper

Minecraft: 1.21+ (built and tested on modern Paper/Spigot APIs).​

Ideal for SMPs, event servers, and admin meme moments where you want announcements to look loud, colorful, and impossible to ignore.​
